I think we're defining morality in two different ways. You seem to define morality as (loosely speaking) "whatever set of rules or social norms that would lead to the most prosperous society". I define morality as (loosely speaking) "what behavior people feel is good or evil".

You can't define things based on individual feelings. Or rather you can, but the definition becomes completely useless because it doesn't actually categorize anything. Your definition has to encompass 7 billion points of reference to be complete.
